name: character-pipeline-v0
summary: Teacher chats filtered by a fabrication checker, a per-turn d1-2B judge and human review; one shared LoRA SFT checkpoint on a Base student; DPO, KTO and continued-SFT arms branched from it with the SFT frozen as reference; scored under multi-turn pushback.
status: Code smoke-tested end to end on a tiny model; not yet run on Golem.

sources.sft loop: Aineko run 1 train.py (aineko-character-training 709b345): micro-batch 1, accumulation 4, lr 1e-4, 5% warm-up then cosine, clip 1.0, assistant-only loss
sources.dpo: Aineko oct/run_stage.py: TRL 1.14.1 sigmoid DPO, beta 0.1, precomputed reference log-probs; lr 1e-6 was a CPU feasibility value, not tuned for 4B
sources.kto: Aineko loom/kto_pilot.py: TRL KTO, 2-step pilot only
sources.rejected side: the student's own sample on the identical prefix (Aineko OCT; Open Character Training uses the untrained student)
